storylines.text: Juan Soto is running hot right now, hitting well above his 0.253 season average over his last games with at least one home run in that stretch. He faces LAD sends out Roki Sasaki today, in a pitcher-friendly park, a pitcher who's allowed a 0.246 average against this season.

Griffin Conine is running hot right now, hitting well above his 0.293 season average over his last games with at least one home run in that stretch. He faces SD sends out Germán Márquez today, in a pitcher-friendly park, a pitcher who's allowed a 0.270 average against this season.

Kyle Schwarber is running hot right now, hitting well above his 0.228 season average over his last games with at least one home run in that stretch. He faces NYY sends out Cam Schlittler today, in a park that plays up for power, a pitcher who's allowed a 0.205 average against this season.

Hunter Goodman is running hot right now, hitting well above his 0.283 season average over his last games with at least one home run in that stretch. He faces MIL sends out Shane Drohan today, in a park that plays up for power, a pitcher who's allowed a 0.239 average against this season.

Byron Buxton is in a real home run drought — none in his last 10 games — but the underlying indicators haven't cooled the same way: a .208 ISO and a 0.899 OPS this season say the power is still there, it just hasn't landed yet. ATH sends out Jacob Lopez today.
